rules.title: Removes API that a related change still uses
rules.description: A public symbol removed here is still used by a change request above this one in the cascade.
rules.fix: Migrate the consumer first, or keep the symbol deprecated for one more release.

rules.title: Adds a required parameter that a related change does not pass
rules.description: A function gets a parameter without a default, and a change request above this one still calls it.
rules.fix: Give the parameter a default, or update the callers.

rules.title: expect declaration without an actual
rules.description: An expect declaration has no actual in a platform source set of its module.
rules.why: The module does not compile for that target.
rules.fix: Add the actual declaration to the platform source set.
